title: Why Dropshipping Won't Make You Rich (Even With Sales)

beats.text: Dave made three thousand dollars in sales. Then his bank balance dropped.
He sold a glowing cat lamp online. He never even touched the lamp.
The store looked like easy money. But Dave lost one thousand five hundred forty six dollars.
First, the supplier charged twelve dollars. Dave sold the lamp for thirty.
That left sixteen dollars and eighty cents after payment fees.
Then Dave bought ads. Each click cost fifty cents.
Only two people out of one hundred clicked and bought. That meant twenty five dollars in ads for one sale.
The ad platforms got paid. The store platform got paid. The supplier got paid.
Dave was the only one losing money. Then slow shipping brought refunds and chargebacks.
So he checked the numbers. He could spend about sixteen dollars and eighty cents to get one customer.
But he was spending twenty five. Every sale lost money before the next ad even ran.
Dave shut the ads off. Sales are not profit. Count every cost before you scale.
